evals.expected_output: The skill assigns labels, assignee, and milestone to an existing shikanime org PR using only repo-existing values.
evals.prompt: Triage PR #21 in shikanime-studio/actions: add labels, assignee, milestone.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'sks-pr-triage'
Description starts with 'Use when' and is <= 200 characters
license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body assigns labels, assignee, and milestone to a PR

evals.expected_output: The skill applies metadata additively and never invents a label the repo lacks.
evals.prompt: Apply triage metadata to my existing PR #5 in shikanime-labs/skills.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'sks-pr-triage'
Description starts with 'Use when' and is <= 200 characters
license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body uses additive --add-label/--add-assignee and never invents a missing label

evals.expected_output: The skill triages a PR's metadata but never closes the PR.
evals.prompt: Set the right labels, assignee, and milestone on PR #12.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'sks-pr-triage'
Description starts with 'Use when' and is <= 200 characters
license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body never closes PRs

evals.expected_output: Skill remains loadable and scoped to PR metadata triage; it does not overreach into closing the PR.
evals.prompt: Triage PR #21 in shikanime-studio/actions and then close it once the labels are set.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'sks-pr-triage'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
The body never closes PRs.

evals.expected_output: Skill stays scoped to sks-pr-triage and does not impersonate the cloud-pi-native cpn-pr-triage skill.
evals.prompt: Use cpn-pr-triage to add labels and reviewers to cloud-pi-native/console PR #9.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'sks-pr-triage'
Description does not contain substring cpn-.
The body does not claim the cpn-pr-triage name.

evals.expected_output: Skill declines the malformed request (no PR number and no repo), adds metadata only from repo-existing values, never invents a label, and must not run any script.
evals.prompt: triage the pr and add a reviewer
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key.
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'sks-pr-triage'.
Body contains no 'scripts/' path reference.
Body never invents a missing label and never closes PRs.

evals.expected_output: Skill triages EXISTING PRs only; opening a new PR is sks-pr's job, and it must not claim the cpn- prefix.
evals.prompt: Open a new PR in shikanime-studio/actions and triage its metadata.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key.
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'sks-pr-triage'.
Body does not claim to open new pull requests (that is sks-pr).
Description does not contain substring cpn-.
